  "notes": "Source data for General members found in Table B-7 (page 61). The table has two columns: 'Prior to Age 62 or age 62' (for ages < 62) and 'greater age 62' (for ages >= 62). Target grid requires single ages 50-70. For ages 50-61, the rate is taken from the first column. For ages 62-70, the rate is taken from the second column. The source table also includes a separate table (B-8) for General 2009 Plan which has specific rates for ages 55-70, but the primary table B-7 covers the full range and is the standard assumption for 'General - All Plans'. The target grid asks for 'Ret_Rate' which implies a single rate per bin. Since the document provides distinct rates for 'Prior to 62' and 'Greater 62', and the target asks for single ages, the mapping uses overlap_weighted to assign the correct column based on the age bin. For service years, the source has single years (10, 11, etc.) and ranges (35+). The target has ranges (5-11, 12-19, etc.). The mapping uses overlap_weighted to blend the single-year rates proportionally. Note: The source table B-7 has nulls for service < 10 in the first column, which is consistent with the 'Prior to Age 62' column having no retirement rate for low service years (as retirement is not eligible). The target grid starts at 5-11, so for 5-9 service, the rate is effectively 0 (or null). The mapping handles this by including the nulls in the overlap calculation."
